revenue_growth.source: Assumption: fades from FY2026 growth of 15.1% (478,834 vs 416,161) toward ~4%, reflecting law of large numbers; 3-yr history 6.4%-15.1%.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2026 level 33.0% (158,063/478,834); up from 31.5% FY2024 and 32.0% FY2025; no further expansion assumed.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 implied effective rate ~17% = 1 - net income 132,175 / pretax 159,237 (10-K 0000320193-26-000026).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: 3-yr average capex/revenue (2.4%, 3.1%, 1.9%) ≈ 2.4%, rounded to 2.2% leaning to recent; slightly below D&A+ is conservative to review.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US 10Y Treasury, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.1 (my assumption, not pulled from Damodaran) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = 9.8% cost of equity; debt ~80bn vs equity far larger so weight on debt <5%; WACC rounded to 9.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth.

net_debt.source: deskstack financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 80,111 (LT 68,208 + current 9,906 + CP 1,997) - cash 36,305 - marketable securities 20,417; 10-K 0000320193-26-000026

diluted_shares.source: Weighted avg diluted shares 14,720,306,000 (WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding), 10-K 0000320193-26-000026, in millions
